medianGrossRent.source: Median gross rent, ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B25064), U.S. Census Bureau: Chapel Hill town, North Carolina. https://censusreporter.org/data/table/?table=B25064&geo_ids=16000US3711800
medianGrossRent.note: The newest town-level survey: Chapel Hill (about 62,000 people) is too small for 1-year ACS estimates, and the 2021-2025 5-year release comes in December 2026. Earlier vintage: $1,483 (2019-2023).

meanCommuteMin.source: Mean travel time to work = aggregate minutes (B08013) / workers who did not work from home (B08303), ACS 2020-2024 5-year, Chapel Hill town: 19.52 minutes. https://censusreporter.org/data/table/?table=B08013&geo_ids=16000US3711800

medianHomeValue.source: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B25077), Chapel Hill town, North Carolina. https://censusreporter.org/data/table/?table=B25077&geo_ids=16000US3711800

population.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 population estimates for cities and towns (SUB-EST2025), Chapel Hill town, NC, July 1, 2025 (Orange County part 60,643 + Durham County part 2,922). https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2025/cities/totals/sub-est2025_37.csv
population.note: 2020 Census count: 61,960. ACS 2020-2024 (household population 50,403 + group quarters 11,204): 61,607.

housingUnits.source: Housing units, ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B25001), Chapel Hill town, NC: 21,189 occupied and 2,392 vacant (B25002). https://censusreporter.org/data/table/?table=B25001&geo_ids=16000US3711800
housingUnits.note: Same survey as the households, renters and incomes in shared/luti/data.js, so vacancy is measured consistently. The Census Bureau publishes no newer count of homes for towns (its housing-unit estimates stop at counties). 2020 Census: 23,713. Building permits since (Census BPS): 151 in 2020, 450 in 2021, 200 in 2022, 739 in 2023, 159 in 2024, 155 in 2025 and 109 in January-August 2026.

treeCoverPct.source: USFS / MRLC NLCD Tree Canopy Cover, CONUS v2021-4, 30 m. https://www.mrlc.gov/geoserver/mrlc_download/wcs
treeCoverPct.note: Our calculation: mean canopy of the pixels inside the map area (bbox in meridian-city/fetch_osm.py). The Town publishes no official canopy figure. 30 m data reads low in urban areas; EPA EnviroAtlas 1 m land cover (2010) gives 50.3% over the same area.

mapAreaAcres.source: Derived: the 2.8 km square the map covers (bbox in meridian-city/fetch_osm.py)
